standard.summary: Loss 门控余弦（loss_gated_cosine）/ Loss 加权退火余弦（loss_weighted_annealed_cosine）调度器的 EMA 平滑系数，控制 loss 平滑度以过滤 batch 抖动。
standard.effect: 值越大（接近 1）= 对 loss 波动越不敏感，需要持续更长时间的下降才视为"有效下降"；值越小 = 响应更快但容易被噪声影响。
standard.whenToUse: 配合 loss_gated_cosine 或 loss_weighted_annealed_cosine 调度器使用，让调度器的「进退」决策基于平滑后的 loss，而非单步噪声。
standard.avoidWhen: 使用其他调度器（cosine_with_restarts / linear 等）时这些参数均无效。

standard_en.summary: The EMA smoothing coefficient for the loss-gated cosine (loss_gated_cosine) and loss-weighted annealed cosine (loss_weighted_annealed_cosine) schedulers; it sets how much the loss is smoothed to filter batch jitter.
standard_en.effect: Larger (closer to 1) is less sensitive to loss fluctuation and needs a longer sustained fall to count as real progress; smaller responds faster but is more easily swayed by noise.
standard_en.whenToUse: Together with the loss_gated_cosine or loss_weighted_annealed_cosine scheduler, so its hold-or-advance decisions rest on the smoothed loss rather than single-step noise.
standard_en.avoidWhen: These parameters have no effect with any other scheduler (cosine_with_restarts, linear and so on).

advanced.principle: loss_ema = ema_alpha × loss_ema + (1-ema_alpha) × current_loss，用平滑 loss 替代原始 loss 做调度决策。min_delta / relative_delta 定义"有效下降"的阈值；patience 是连续多少次无效下降才推进余弦相位；cooldown 防止来回抖动；max_hold_steps 限制最长锁定时间。
advanced.tradeoffs: 参数组合较多，调整时建议一次只改一个参数观察效果。loss_gated_cosine 比 cosine_with_restarts 更复杂但对 loss 收敛的响应更精准。

advanced_en.principle: loss_ema = ema_alpha × loss_ema + (1-ema_alpha) × current_loss, using the smoothed loss for scheduling decisions. min_delta / relative_delta define what counts as "meaningful decline"; patience is how many ineffective declines must occur before the cosine phase advances; cooldown prevents oscillation back and forth; max_hold_steps caps the longest lock.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Many interacting parameters — change one at a time when tuning. loss_gated_cosine is more complex than cosine_with_restarts but responds more precisely to loss convergence.
